en: The image is an old black-and-white or sepia-toned photograph showing a cobblestone street lined with historic buildings. A prominent building with arched windows and a steeply gabled roof stands at the end of the street. Pedestrians and a horse-drawn carriage are visible, suggesting the image is from the early 20th century. The text at the bottom identifies the street as Kirchgasse and highlights the Kgl. Bergamt (Royal Mining Office) in Freiberg.
